description: The project's MCP entries for Claude Code: poly's own tools, and polyflow's server over the project's lowered workflows (PT10, AC5). Claude Code reads them from the project's .mcp.json.
notes: The plugin (the language server and the skill): claude plugin marketplace add ${POLY_ROOT}/adapters, then claude plugin install poly@poly.
Workflows run on polyflow, outside poly's gate (S164): run poly check first, so .poly/build/workflows holds the checked descriptors.
